# ToolAspect

> 2,000+ free online tools — calculators, converters, and generators. No sign-up, no limits, works on any device.

ToolAspect (toolaspect.com) offers free browser-based utilities across finance,
health, construction, legal, business, auto, developer, and everyday categories.
Every tool runs instantly with no registration.

## Popular tools

- [Tip Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/tip-calculator/): Calculate tips and split bills per person
- [BMI Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/bmi-calculator/): Body mass index with healthy range
- [Age Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/age-calculator/): Exact age in years, months, days
- [Percentage Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/percentage-calculator/): Percent of, change, difference
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/mortgage-calculator/): Monthly payments + amortization
- [Unit Converter](https://toolaspect.com/unit-converter/): Length, weight, volume, temperature
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/auto-loan-calculator/): Car payments and interest
- [Merge PDF](https://toolaspect.com/pdf-merge/): Combine PDF files offline, entirely in your browser
- [Compress PDF](https://toolaspect.com/compress-pdf/): Shrink PDF file size free, no upload to third parties
- [PimEyes Alternatives](https://toolaspect.com/pimeyes-alternative/): Free face search engines compared — privacy-first options
- [Social Security Calculator](https://toolaspect.com/social-security-calculator/): Estimate benefits by claiming age
- [Home Repair Costs by State](https://toolaspect.com/home-repair-costs-by-state/): 2026 roof, fence, window, and HVAC cost tables for all 50 states
